modelspec.benchmark.FlopRule.title: FlopRule
modelspec.benchmark.FlopRule.description: What flop_per_step counts. MatmulOnly counts the matrix products of a step, forward and backward, by workload, `3196·B·H` for `mlp-784-H-10`, the matmuls of a 784 → H → 10 step at batch B, and `N·(42·H² + 24·H·F + 24·S·H)` with `N = B·S`, `H = 128`, `F = 512` and `S = 128`, that is `339,738,624·B`, for `transformer-block` at a batch of B sequences (benches/transformer_block/block.rs), and `N·(54·H² + 24·H·F + 6·H·V + 24·S·H)` with `V = 8,192`, that is `1,170,210,816·B`, for `bert-tiny-pretrain` (benches/bert_tiny/flop.rs); AllSites is the `profile step_total` count over every dispatch site of the step (DESIGN.md § 3.1 counting rule).
